# RoyalAlert

> RoyalAlert is a lightweight, dependency-free Vanilla JavaScript alert, dialog, and toast notification library developed by Royal Technologies.

RoyalAlert provides modern user interaction components for websites and web applications without requiring jQuery, Bootstrap, or other external JavaScript dependencies.

## Project Resources
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Royal-Technologies/RoyalAlert): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [Documentation & Demo](https://royal-technologies.github.io/RoyalAlert/): Official documentation and interactive examples.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/royal-alert): Installation package.

## API Overview
- **Basic Alerts**: Success, error, warning, info, and question alerts via `RoyalAlert.fire()`.
- **Confirmation**: Confirmation dialogs via `RoyalAlert.confirm()`.
- **Toast**: Toast notification API via `RoyalAlert.toast()`.
- **Prompt**: User input dialogs via `RoyalAlert.prompt()`.
- **Async**: Async operation handling and loading dialogs via `RoyalAlert.async()`.
- **Themes**: Light, dark, and automatic themes.
- **Animations**: Scale, fade, slide, flip.

## Installation
- CDN: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/royal-alert/dist/royal-alert.min.js`
- npm: `npm install royal-alert`

## Organization
- [Royal Technologies](https://www.royaltechbd.com): Developer and maintainer of RoyalAlert.
